title: Kagamine Len — Original Style〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
All together now!
Here we go!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: See you three later!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Putting on a show together really is the best! It's like I get more in the spirit the longer we sing!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Me too!
How about everyone here at the venue?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Wah...! So many cheers!
Thanks, everyone♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: How about all of you at the remote screenings and everybody watching the stream?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<I'm having so much fun!>
<The call-and-response part was great!>
<I'm glad we got to join in the call-and-response even with comments.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Looking pretty good!
Thanks for joining the call-and-response!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh yeah, this show is getting streamed around the world, right? So...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey! Are you having fun?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Wow, English!
Did you practice that ahead of time?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hehehe, a little!
Just now, I asked everybody whether they're having fun.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Yeah!>
<Awesome!>
<Sooooo fun!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Ooh, and I'm getting responses in English too! Uh... Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO & Miku
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Looks like people overseas are enjoying this too.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Still, this is pretty amazing.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I mean, right at this moment, people all around the world are watching our show!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's evening in Shibuya right now, but for people on the other side of the globe, it's the middle of the day, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: In fact, there may be some people watching this later at night, or very early in the morning.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Whoa...! If it was the middle of the night for me, would I actually be able to stay up until the show started...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Actually, I'm not even sure I'd be able to get up early for it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh? Even with such a wonderfully fun show waiting for you?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I mean, I get that, but...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sure some people watching our show right now did stay up late or wake up incredibly early for us.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Everybody out there watching our stream! Let me say it again, thank you for coming to see our show!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We're able to sing at such an incredible venue because you all listen to our songs.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We're gonna keep pumping up the heat so even all of you beyond the screen can feel it!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So all of you on the stream, I hope you bring the energy too in the comments!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Of course!>
<I'll enjoy every second to the fullest!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright, and a message for people overseas... Thank you for coming to the VIRTUAL SINGERS Show!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I can sing thanks to everyone's support! Let's enjoy it together till the last!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So you came up with an English version of that part too.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yup!
I put just as much effort in as I did remembering all my lyrics!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<ty, Len!>
<okeyyyyy!>
<Let's enjoy this!!!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Looks like you made your feelings understood to them, Len!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm glad!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Ah, but this isn't the time to breathe a sigh of relief, is it?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You said we'd be pumping things up, so we need to keep that promise.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Alright!
I'm gonna sing my hardest!
